speaker: Doctor
text: That history of rash suggests a potential antibiotic allergy, but your current fever and flank pain point toward a kidney infection rather than an allergic reaction alone. Can you tell me if you are experiencing chills, nausea, or vomiting, and have you had any urinary frequency or urgency?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is interesting; the absence of dysuria and nausea makes a typical ascending infection slightly less likely, though atypical presentations occur. Given your recent antibiotic use, have you noticed any new skin rashes or swelling in your legs or face recently? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) and C-Reactive Protein (CRP).
